skin.char_1001_amiya2@casc#1.description.text: She once dreamed of what the stars looked like. Perhaps one day, her footprints will be left on the far side of deep space, where those stars rest eternally.

skin.char_1001_amiya2@casc#1.dialog.text: CASC Collaboration Outfit/Touching the Stars, co-designed by Amiya. Equipped with a precise life support system, it balances survival performance with comfort, making it fully capable of handling the extreme environments of outer space.

skin.char_1016_agoat2@epoque#57.descript.text: "Mom, Dad, please sit down with me. These are all stories I wrote down myself, and now I'm going to tell them to you."

skin.char_1016_agoat2@epoque#57.dialog.text: EPOQUE Collection New Arrival/Tales After. Adele's favorite casual outfit. The comforting feel brought by the soft, cozy loungewear and fluffy slippers evokes her most cherished memories.

skin.char_1027_greyy2@wild#12.descriptio.text: Though he has already flown past countless islands and mountain peaks, his desire to explore is far from satisfied. Turning the control wheel of the balloon, he records the scenery of one last woodland before night falls.

skin.char_1027_greyy2@wild#12.dialog.text: Pioneer Series Classic/Thousand-Foot Overlook. Made from special materials with functional designs, it can adapt to various environmental changes and satisfy all kinds of needs.

skin.char_1033_swire2@nlc#1.description.text: "The ancients compiled classics to record knowledge, while modern people inherit wisdom. What I need to do is integrate it all, apply the past to the present, and bring a new look to Lungmen! How about that? Not bad, right?"

skin.char_1033_swire2@nlc#1.dialog.text: National Library Collaboration Outfit/Age of Prosperity. The outfit Swire wore when attending a cultural festival. Medicine, technology, art, and craft—she decorated each booth with brilliant displays, wearing history on her shoulders to grandly welcome guests from all over the world.

skin.char_1035_wisdel@game#9.description.text: By her own assessment, this is the most bizarre character design in history.

skin.char_1035_wisdel@game#9.dialog.text: Achievement Star Series/Absolute Protagonist. Wis'adel's altered appearance in a special gaming event. Judging from her temper, you can tell she is still very much the same Wis'adel.

skin.char_1040_blaze2@nlc#1.description.text: Following the descriptions in the book, crossing mountains and rivers across five regions and sailing beyond the four seas, Blaze finally saw the legendary creature. "Your name should be... uh... how do you pronounce this ancient word again?"

skin.char_1040_blaze2@nlc#1.dialog.text: National Library Collaboration Outfit/Nocturnal Flame. The outfit Blaze wore while traveling through various exotic lands of Yan. The book holds a myriad of landscapes, her hands hold a blazing light, and with auspicious beasts by her side, she steps forward through the flames.

skin.char_1042_phatm2@sightseer#4.descri.text: You suddenly forget why you came here, nor can you recall your original intention of watching this performance under the sun. But this is a journey to find the true self, and inadvertently, the voice of one of his selves reaches your ears.

skin.char_1042_phatm2@sightseer#4.dialog.text: PhaseZero Collection Special/Self-Restraint. Under the blazing midday sun, amid the warbling of liberi on Olive Square, a dazzling art that bestows philosophy upon onlookers is being performed.

skin.char_1044_hsgma2@whirlwind#11.descr.text: Fancy a street-car chase, or a duel of martial skills in the park? You choose the challenge, but whether to show mercy is up to her.

skin.char_1044_hsgma2@whirlwind#11.dialo.text: 0011 Sub-brand Speed Series New Arrival/Glinting Determination. Designed for those with an awe-inspiring presence who can sweep away evil on the streets. The exorcism talismans stand out even more under the glow of the blue flame, reflecting her heroic and fearless Oni demeanor.

skin.char_1046_sbell2@ambienceSynesthesi.text: Bringing a soul-soothing hymn and the announcement of light's return to those trapped in the haze and blizzard, unable to move forward.

Ambience Synesthesia Special/Dawn Hymn. The layers of dark clouds lingering over time have finally broken apart. The cloak lining adorned with morning stars symbolizes the purified sky, while the headdress she wears blossoms with a radiant dawn.

skin.char_194_leto@sightseer#4.descripti.text: Leaving this place, will tomorrow bring another unavoidable bitterness? "As long as you remember how to sing the ballads, any despondency is just a passing cloud." She plucks the strings, answering your question with a song.

skin.char_194_leto@sightseer#4.dialog.text: PhaseZero Collection Special/Songs of Tomorrow. Between the decorations of the corridor and under the rising night sky, a joyful melody flows, making visitors reluctant to leave.

skin.char_2025_shu@nlc#1.description.text: "When spring rain is scarce, water the fields; when summer rain is plentiful, open the channels." Shu still remembers the scene long ago when she and the people recorded this agricultural proverb in the scrolls together. Today, the paper from back then has yellowed, while the rice fields beneath her feet are lush and green.

skin.char_2025_shu@nlc#1.dialog.text: National Library Collaboration Outfit/Longstanding Stream. The outfit Shu wore while working at the Tianshi Bureau. Ancient scrolls unfold before her, and wisdom passed down through generations emerges on paper, flowing ceaselessly forward just like the long river under her feet.

skin.char_219_meteo@summer#22.descriptio.text: Is this her first time letting down her guard and relaxing so leisurely? Just look at her smile in the cool breeze under the stars and moon, and the answer becomes self-evident.

skin.char_219_meteo@summer#22.dialog.text: Coral Coast/Summer Flowers Series Swimsuit Model 240 by MARTHE. Tailored to a young woman's figure and build, made with natural materials. Pursuing this summer's top design trends.

skin.char_264_f12yin@marthe#13.descripti.text: Though the resting rider appears calm and composed, once he puts on his helmet, the roar of the engine and soul will be etched into the quiet night.

skin.char_264_f12yin@marthe#13.dialog.text: MARTHE Sportswear Series New Arrival/Hardcore Speed. A riding suit specially designed for competitive motorcycle racers, featuring windproof fabric and reinforced joint padding to ensure top-tier safety protection while maintaining comfort.

skin.char_281_popka@sale#18.description.text: At this moment, her growth, along with that mirror image she has never met, will not be merely a passing bubble.

skin.char_281_popka@sale#18.dialog.text: Test Collection/Tranquil Bamboo. An outfit slightly adjusted from the formal attire of an exotic ruler. No mysterious power is needed; after undergoing the baptism of time, Popukar has gradually embraced new changes.

skin.char_328_cammou@summer#22.descripti.text: For Caper, rather than the summer scenery and relaxing time she experienced herself, being able to shoot the most fun holiday video in history with other Operators is the real reason she came to this beach.

skin.char_328_cammou@summer#22.dialog.text: Coral Coast/Holiday Series Swimsuit Model 59 by MARTHE. Comfortable, relaxing, breathable, and light. Allows you to enjoy the most perfect beach experience in a casual environment.

skin.char_336_folivo@wild#11.description.text: Scene gazes at the wilderness while her "lens" searches for the ruins of old cities. Humans transform nature, and nature washes away human traces; history stacks textures here, captured by Scene through her "lens."

skin.char_336_folivo@wild#11.dialog.text: Pioneer Series Classic/New Terrain. Made from special materials with functional designs, it can adapt to various environmental changes and satisfy all kinds of needs.

skin.char_4015_spuria@epoque#58.descript.text: On days off, she will also step out of her room with her meticulously decorated drone, humming a song to leisurely enjoy an afternoon without field assignments.

skin.char_4015_spuria@epoque#58.dialog.text: EPOQUE Collection New Arrival/Languid Humming. Crafted from soft, lightweight fabric, it adds a distinctive bow tie as a neck ornament without compromising flexibility, making it the top choice for strolling around when off duty.

skin.char_4026_vulpis@epoque#55.descript.text: Tabloid journalists, enemies, detectives... Many have tried to capture a candid moment of her. But the real Ms. Ingrid is never trapped in a single focal plane; she exists beyond the focus.

skin.char_4026_vulpis@epoque#55.dialog.text: EPOQUE Collection New Arrival/Out of Focus. The outfit Honeysweet wore while watching an opera in Siracusa. The new synthetic fabric presents a dazzling shine under the flashlights, reflecting similar yet different colors from every angle.

skin.char_4051_akkord@summer#23.descript.text: A duet of blue waves and sea breeze accompanied by the distant harmony of Fowlsbeasts. Without her recorder this time, she captures this wonderful summer song with her own ears.

skin.char_4051_akkord@summer#23.dialog.text: MARTHE Coral Coast Series/Carefree Holiday HD91. Comfortable and relaxed, breathable and lightweight, allowing you to enjoy the ultimate beach experience in a leisure environment.

skin.char_4080_lin@littlePony#1.descript.text: Even if no one knows, they silently gather knowledge and experience, never stopping their steps. Friends are the magic that keeps them going.

skin.char_4080_lin@littlePony#1.dialog.text: MY LITTLE PONY Crossover Apparel - Magic of Knowledge. Late at night, they are still swimming in the magical world of knowledge. They shoulder their due responsibilities for themselves and for those around them.

skin.char_4117_ray@summer#22.description.text: The humid air brings the warmth of summer, and the faint chirping of insects colors the peaceful moment. Riding her bicycle from the bustling beach to a hidden resting spot, she lets her thoughts and memories flow quietly in the scenery.

skin.char_4117_ray@summer#22.dialog.text: MARTHE Coral Coast Series/Summer Flower FA098. Made from natural materials tailored to a young girl's figure and build. Pursuing this summer's top design trends.

skin.char_4138_narant@littlePony#1.descr.text: Even when in trouble, they open their hearts and candidly reveal their truest selves. They have always been this honest.

skin.char_4138_narant@littlePony#1.dialo.text: MY LITTLE PONY Crossover Apparel - Straightforward and Honest One. They are passionate and reliable, like sweet-smelling apples under the sun, constantly infecting others with smiles and giving everyone courage.

skin.char_4165_ctrail@yun#11.description.text: At this moment, crossing a bridge formed by countless Fowlsbeasts, she will encounter the most breathtaking sky scenery.

skin.char_4165_ctrail@yun#11.dialog.text: 0011 Sub-brand - Yun Series / Crossing Clear Skies. An outfit specially designed for Cloudrail by Yan artisans. The loose-fitting dress paired with a silk fan and ribbons allows her to feel at ease in whatever sky she flies.

skin.char_4171_wulfen@marthe#14.descript.text: Welcome our cheerleader! With Molybdenum Lead around, the mood will never go cold!

skin.char_4171_wulfen@marthe#14.dialog.text: MARTHE Sportswear Series / Vibrant Beat. A cheerleader uniform made of special elastic fiber that guarantees lightness and flexibility while balancing breathability and comfort. Molybdenum Lead waving her pom-poms is destined to be the center of attention.

skin.char_4191_tippi@epoque#57.descripti.text: Today, Tibi isn't a staff member busy behind the scenes. In this set, she is the one and only protagonist.

skin.char_4191_tippi@epoque#57.dialog.text: EPOQUE Series / Fresh Set Design. Outfit worn by Tibi when participating in a mini-play performance. Cool summer attire paired with a straw hat smelling of sunshine, capturing the girl's most natural poise on camera.

skin.char_4194_rmixer@boc#12.description.text: You are the light of the innocent; you are the night of the guilty. Though you walk upon the earth, you bear the majesty of the heavens.

skin.char_4194_rmixer@boc#12.dialog.text: Bloodline of Combat Series - The Dawn Sky. Crisis and hardship never cease in just a single moment; true guardians protect the eternal alternation of day and night without a moment's rest. Faith Blender was born for this exact purpose.

skin.char_4196_reckpr@yun#12.description.text: When the shawl draped over his shoulders, Yun Qingping, invited to perform, finally realized the weight this garment bore. He raised his lantern and took the pose of actors he saw in his childhood, drawing thunderous applause from the audience.

skin.char_4196_reckpr@yun#12.dialog.text: 0011 Sub-brand - Yun Series / Illuminating the Realm. A stage costume made by tailors in Baizao for classic Yan opera. Intricate yet elegant tailoring paired with a softly glowing lantern highlights the solemnity of the festival.

skin.char_4198_christ@epoque#56.descript.text: The night sky on a joyous day is low-key, hidden, and warm like soft underfur. Miss.Christine makes a quiet entrance, capturing every gaze. Only elegant guests are invited tonight; please be sure not to use flash photography.

skin.char_4198_christ@epoque#56.dialog.text: EPOQUE Series / Underfur Ball. Attire worn by Miss.Christine when attending evening balls. Hazy light gauze paired with golden star-like pendants fully displays her elegant and languid temperament.

skin.char_4199_makiri@sale#19.descriptio.text: He smiles facing the gun muzzle, but whether composure or helplessness lies behind the corner of his mouth, not even he himself can tell.

skin.char_4199_makiri@sale#19.dialog.text: Test Collection / Dusk's Gemlight. Attire worn by Mori Toru after acquiring endless wealth, only to step into solitude in the end. A tailored suit paired with a coat featuring a gold-purple lining; though its luxurious temperament is clear on the outside, it cannot hide his inner fatigue.

skin.char_4204_mantra@sightseer#4.descri.text: The night is boundless, and the endless clamor recedes from her mind. The stars return to their places, all things fade into silence, and in this completely unfamiliar quiet, she finally falls asleep for the first time, and truly awakens for the first time.

skin.char_4204_mantra@sightseer#4.dialog.text: Misaligned Pilgrimage Redefined [Phase Zero] Series Special / All Sounds Silenced. Inside the inner hall of the Indigo Palace, beneath elegant garments lies deep wisdom that conveys the path forward to audience-seekers without a single word.

skin.char_4207_branch@yun#10.description.text: Gather a wisp of dense, fragrant mist and store it in a basket, letting it accompany you from ice plains to mountains and lakes. When you pause to rest, you will find the mugwort leaves in the basket are still green and the dew has not yet dried.

skin.char_4207_branch@yun#10.dialog.text: 0011 Sub-brand - Yun Series / Gathering Fragrant Mists. Traditional spring outing clothing made from Yan silk. Even those raised in the cold northern lands can feel the warm atmosphere of midsummer mist.

skin.char_4215_buddy@mh#2.description.text: Masamune's recent interest is researching new Bunny Dango recipes using Terran ingredients. As for the results, just look at Yoshitsune's expression to find out.

skin.char_4215_buddy@mh#2.dialog.text: MONSTER HUNTER Crossover Apparel - Camp Time Meow! Tailor-made outfit for the Covert Squad who love outdoor activities in mountains and forests, featuring excellent mobility and breathability.

skin.char_4217_makoto@p3r#1.description.text: True glory needs no idolization; the generous and fair sun bestows it upon everyone.

skin.char_4217_makoto@p3r#1.dialog.text: Persona 3 Reload Crossover Apparel - Witness to Glory. Costume worn by Makoto Yuki when performing at the campus drama festival. The executioner who rejected judgment walks out of the hall, where freedom and true glory await him.

skin.char_4218_aigis@p3r#1.description.text: Some answers are worth pursuing for a lifetime, grown from daily morning watering and devotion.

skin.char_4218_aigis@p3r#1.dialog.text: Persona 3 Reload Crossover Apparel - Contemplating Truth. Costume worn by Aigis when performing at the campus drama festival. A monk's life is long and peaceful; she observes the growth of plants, seeking the answer to an unknown question.

skin.char_4219_yukari@p3r#1.description.text: Morning and evening, twilight and dawn, clouds flow and winds turn. White walls enclose many warm lives—that is what they call a city.

skin.char_4219_yukari@p3r#1.dialog.text: Persona 3 Reload Crossover Apparel - Guarding Twilight. Costume worn by Yukari Takeba when performing at the campus drama festival. A guard looks into the distance atop white walls; the peaceful dusk is her reward after a long journey.

skin.char_4220_kormr@p3r#1.description.text: They all dream within a dream, waking up with a smile still lingering on their lips—that is what makes a good sleep.

skin.char_4220_kormr@p3r#1.dialog.text: Persona 3 Reload Crossover Apparel - Soaring Over the Sweet City. Outfit Koromaru often wears in Laterano. All the desserts in the city flew into the sky around Koromaru, eagerly hoping he would take a bite—Wait, it was a dream?!

skin.char_423_blemsh@littlePony#1.descri.text: What dispels the mist like a golden light is not a sword, nor a shield, nor a staff, but the kindness deep in their hearts.

skin.char_423_blemsh@littlePony#1.dialog.text: MY LITTLE PONY Crossover Apparel - Kind and Strong Heart. They all have times of weakness and fear, but in the end they will surely stand up and give their all for those who matter to them.

skin.char_478_kirara@epoque#57.descripti.text: "That tricolor ice cream shop I just went to was so good! I'll send the picture to Utage, gotta go back with her next time!"

skin.char_478_kirara@epoque#57.dialog.text: EPOQUE Collection/Casual Snapshot. Kirara's outfit while hanging out on the streets of Mishiro. With a comfortable knit vest, an eye-catching miniskirt, and cute colorful hair accessories, this snapshot is sure to be a huge hit.

skin.char_494_vendla@game#10.description.text: "Find her... protect her." The labyrinth gardener guards the only exit, the rosebud beneath her armor forever pointing toward the princess.

skin.char_494_vendla@game#10.dialog.text: Star of the Chef Collection/Enigma of the Rose. The outfit Briar wore when shooting the poster for the game *Emerald Labyrinth* at a gaming expo. The princess she played completed the sword-dubbing ceremony, and the Rose Knight has possessed an emerald heart ever since.

skin.char_498_inside@summer#22.descripti.text: Must-haves for a rare summer vacation: a hammock, a magazine, and an extra-sweet soda to beat the heat.

skin.char_498_inside@summer#22.dialog.text: MARTHE Coral Coast Collection/Relaxing Vacation HDm25. Male model. Comfortable, relaxed, breathable, and light. Allows you to enjoy the ultimate beach experience in a casual environment.
